definition: A highly specialized pseudanthium (false flower) consisting of a reduced central female flower surrounded by reduced male flowers, all enclosed within a cup-like involucre of fused bracts with marginal glands.

structural_components.female_flower: Single central tricarpellate pistil reduced to an ovary and 3 split styles on an elongating pedicel.
structural_components.male_flowers: Reduced to individual single stamens on jointed pedicels arranged in 5 cymes along the cup base.
structural_components.involucral_cup: Fused bract wall bearing 1-5 marginal nectar glands, often bordered by petaloid appendages.

field_photo_protocol.nectar_glands: Top-down macro (1:1) focusing on gland rim contour and appendage margins.
field_photo_protocol.ovary_surface: Profile macro showing capsule pubescence (glaucous, villous, or glabrous) and bifid styles.
